app.tagline: Study the source, fill in the board, practise by hand, and keep what you learn.
lesson.studyIntro: Knowclick supplements these. Read them, then practise here.
lesson.noStudy: No study material is linked for this lesson yet.
lesson.practiseIntro: Each task is done outside Knowclick in the environment it specifies. Open it, start the clock, try it before revealing the solution, then record how it went so it can return for practice.
known.empty: Nothing earned yet. Look through the Overview, then take the Quiz.
known.hint: Answers appear as you earn them, and grow stronger until you know them.
quiz.hint: Drag a slip onto its place, or press the slip and then the place. Left: {count}.
task.hard: Done, but slowly or with help
review.title: Review
review.intro: What is due today: boards first, one at a time, then tasks. On a board, the answers you aren't being asked for stay visible.
review.none: Nothing is due today. Well done.
review.tasksIntro: Do each one again by hand, then say how it went.
mode.label: Answer by
type.label: Type the answer for
type.hint: Press Enter to check. Press another open place to answer it instead. Left: {count}.
practice.label: Practice level
practice.guided.description: Use answer choices to learn the vocabulary and structure. Guided progress is separate from recall.
practice.recall.description: Type from memory. Choices and surrounding code are hidden so they cannot give away the answer.
practice.apply.description: Solve a practical task with fewer supports. Run its checks, then assess your attempt.
practice.recommended: Recommended next: {level}. You can choose any level.
practice.noTasks: This lesson has no authored practical task yet. You can continue with Guided or Recall.
practice.apply.instructions: Read the task requirements, attempt it before opening the solution, and run the task checks in the stated environment. Results here are self-assessed, not automatically compiler-graded. Use “with help” if you used a hint or solution.
practice.assisted: Assisted practice: hints and revealed answers do not earn unassisted recall progress. Restart for a clean attempt.
practice.revealed: Reference answer — this attempt is assisted:
practice.review.intro: Review the due items for the selected level. Apply reviews practical tasks only.
practice.assisted.complete: Assisted round: {right} of {total} answers matched. This does not count as unassisted recall.
quiz.extraChoices: Some choices do not fit any gap.
home.chooseCourse: Choose a course to see its chapters and continue learning.
